## Actual process-memory telemetry

The new outer launcher preserves the actual Lake/compiler commands and adds only read-only /proc sampling through process_telemetry.py at 0.1 second intervals. It follows the launched process's descendants and records actual lean PIDs with start ticks, command/cwd, VmRSS, VmHWM, VmSize, VmPeak and simultaneous MemAvailable. Samples flush to a bounded JSONL file and summarize observed maxima per process. PID start ticks guard reuse; process exit/read races are counted. No source instrumentation, compiler wrapper, trust change or memory-limit adjustment occurs.

VmHWM/VmPeak are sampled kernel high-water values; a process may exit between samples, so telemetry does not promise observation of its final maximum. VmSize/VmPeak measure virtual address space, not physical RAM . Summed process RSS is not claimed as unique physical occupancy. Historical package-allocation peaks are never reported as process RAM . Missing/incomplete telemetry remains disclosed and blocks a clean telemetry claim even if kernel checking succeeds. The sampler does not make resource decisions; the unchanged supervisor still enforces its limits.
